The document contains engineering specifications for two Triple Offset Rotary On-Off Valves.
Both valves have a flow rate of 843,800 lbm/h and operate at an inlet pressure of 183.9 psia.
Valve bodies are made of ASTM A216 Gr. WCB material with integral arrows indicating the direction of flow.
The actuators are spring-loaded pistons from Tyco Biffi, and they have a travel time of 36 seconds for air and 12 seconds for spring.
Valves are designed to handle temperatures up to 800°F and pressures up to 300 psig.
Valves are designed to handle temperatures up to 527°F and pressures up to 300 psig.
Valve bodies are made of ASTM A216 Gr. WCB material with a rotary triple offset design.
The actuators are spring-loaded pistons from Tyco Biffi.
Communication is via HART protocol, and I/O signals are 4-20mA DC.
Both valves have an integral arrow indicating the direction of flow and require ANSI class V backflow restriction/prevention.
Material certificates and leakage tests are required for both valves.
Both valves have a flow rate of 843,800 lbm/h and operate at an inlet pressure of 243.8 psia.
The valves feature a linear characteristic and a travel range of 0 - 90 degrees.
Communication is handled via HART protocol, and I/O signals are 4-20mA DC.
Both valves require ANSI class V backflow restriction/prevention at design differential pressure.
